name: Casting Unmake removes Buy Time's stasis from the target (#449)
contract: Buy Time 520188's Description ends "Casting Unmake on a target will remove this effect." Its three SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL effects at TARGET_DEST_DEST cast 520185 (allies), 520186 (enemies: SPELL_AURA_DAMAGE_IMMUNITY, SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN, MECHANIC_BANISH, SpellDuration 32 = 6000 ms, radius 8 yd) and 520205. Spell.dbc also ships 807310, rank "Buy Time Remover" of Unmake: SPELL_EFFECT_REMOVE_AURA on TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY with EffectTriggerSpell 520186 and SPELL_ATTR0_NO_IMMUNITIES, but nothing cast it, so Unmake left the enemy banished for the full 6 sec. The golem stands 10 yd from the Chronomancer, so the 8 yd stasis at its position reaches it and not the caster. Unmake rank 1 804418 has a 1.5 sec cast and rank 11 574345 a 2 sec cast; each is started 1.6 sec after Buy Time, so a removal must land by about 3.6 sec, while the stasis without it lasts until 6 sec. Each removal check expires before that 6 sec mark. Spell hit rating is fixtured so the removal cannot miss.

DISCRIMINATING: Unmake rank 1 removes the stasis before it expires

SETUP: the golem is in stasis again
